body.heading: Where in the world is Ukraine?
paragraphs: Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Ukraine is Kyiv.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Ukraine is Ukrainian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Ukraine is the Ukrainian hryvnia.

body.heading: How big is Ukraine?
paragraphs: Ukraine covers about 604,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Italy.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Kyiv's Saint Sophia Cathedral has golden domes and 1,000-year-old mosaics; nearby, the giant Motherland Monument and the cave monastery of Pechersk Lavra crown the Dnipro hills.
Lviv is a city of coffee houses, cobbled squares and churches in the far west — its UNESCO old town feels like a walk through old Europe.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Ukraine on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
